provenance.reference: Controlled black-box observation per Tests/SystemTests/Plans/M2-022-barrier-server-fixtures.md on the owner-approved Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 host: external Barrier server barriers 2.4.0-release protocol 1.6 and external Barrier client barrierc 2.4.0-release protocol 1.6, each on its own virtual X display, through a byte-logging loopback relay. Input was synthetic (xdotool on the server display). TLS disabled for this observation only; product TLS default stays enabled. Server is the Linux Barrier server, not a macOS one; Windows not executed (M2 validation is Linux-only by owner decision, 2026-10-28). Session: handshake, enter, pointer moves, buttons 1-5, drag, wheel in four directions, a key sweep with modifiers and auto-repeat, leave, second enter and leave, and idle keepalive.
